title: Where should things go
subtitle: Pick, for each source server, to keep it on the same machine or move it to another server.
inPlaceNote: Same machine: the sites keep their DNS and the old setup stays until you remove it. In a campaign Tugra takes the server over in place: nothing is copied or rebuilt, so no spare disk space is needed, and you can give it back to Coolify with one click.

lock.match_uncertain: Not sure which server this is. Choose one first.
lock.agent_offline: The agent on this server is offline.
lock.control_plane: This runs Coolify itself. It is handled last.
lock.agent_missing: This server has no Tugra agent yet.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.hint: Moves to another server go together in one run. Each server that stays on its own machine gets its own run, one after the other.
campaign.unreadable: The placement could not be checked. Try again.
campaign.runInPlace: {source} stays on its own machine. Nothing is copied or rebuilt: Tugra starts the images Coolify already built, checks every domain on a temporary address, then takes the ports and gets new certificates. Giving it back to Coolify is one click.
campaign.runOther: {source} moves to {target} (data is copied, then the address is switched).
campaign.create: Create {count} runs and start the first

rebuild.title: Rebuild with Tugra and verify (optional)
rebuild.hint: By default Tugra starts the image Coolify already built and nothing is built. Tick an app to build it with Tugra instead: the build must succeed and the app must answer like Coolify's copy before the ports are taken. An app that shares data with Coolify's copy keeps Coolify's image.
rebuild.none: This server has no apps to rebuild.
rebuild.chosen: {count} to rebuild, the rest reuse Coolify's image.
rebuild.default: None chosen: every app reuses Coolify's image.
rebuild.summary: Apps reuse Coolify's image (default). Build some with Tugra instead

campaign.teamsNote: Your servers are in {count} teams. Tugra creates one campaign per team, all together. Each team's runs are listed below.
campaign.cardInPlace: Stays on its own machine. Nothing is copied: Tugra starts the images Coolify built, tests them on a temporary address, then takes the ports.

failure.placement_empty: Pick at least one source server.
failure.placement_duplicate: A source server is listed twice.
failure.placement_unknown_source: A source server in the choice is not in the plan any more. Read the source again.
failure.placement_in_place_locked: Staying on the same machine is not possible for this server.
failure.placement_in_place_target_mismatch: The server chosen is not the machine this source server runs on.
failure.placement_target_missing: Choose a server to move it to.
failure.placement_target_unknown: The chosen server was not found.
failure.placement_target_not_ready: The chosen server is offline, has no agent connected or cannot deploy.
failure.placement_other_is_source_host: That is the machine the source server already runs on. Choose "same machine" or another server.
failure.placement_rebuild_not_in_place: An app chosen for a rebuild is on a server that is copied to another server. Only apps of servers that stay on their own machine can be rebuilt in place.
failure.placement_rebuild_unknown_item: An app chosen for a rebuild is not in the plan any more. Read the source again.
failure.placement_team_mismatch: This server's Coolify team moves into a different Tugra team than the server you picked. Pick a server of that team, or change the team mapping.
failure.placement_target_shared: These two source servers would land on the same Tugra server, and one of them stays on it. Choose a different server for one of them.
failure.placement_in_place_partial: Only part of this server is picked, but a server that stays on its own machine moves whole, because Tugra takes over the whole machine. Pick everything on it, or move it to another server.
failure.placement_scope_empty: Nothing of this server is picked any more. Change the selection or leave the server out.
failure.placement_scope_invalid: The selection names something the source no longer has. Read the source again.
failure.placement_takeover_busy: Another takeover or guided migration already holds this server. Finish or give it back first.
failure.placement_tugra_proxy_in_use: Tugra's own proxy already serves apps on this server, so the test cannot start it without taking them down. Stop what it serves, or move this server elsewhere.
